context: A doctor explains skincare and household products to a parent
purpose: Teach: 美容/成分/用品/焦点/脇/思わず/現れる/湖

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 先生、最近娘の腕に赤い発疹が現れるんです。思わず声を上げてしまって。
lines.en: Doctor, recently a red rash has been appearing on my daughter's arm. I couldn't help crying out.
lines.style: Worried mother speaking softly with genuine maternal concern in clinic

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: なるほど。まず今使っている美容クリームや日用品の成分を確認させてください。
lines.en: I see. First, let me check the ingredients of the beauty cream and household products you're using.
lines.style: Calm professional doctor speaking methodically with clinical patience

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: これが普段使っている美容用品なんですけど、どうでしょうか。
lines.en: These are the beauty products we usually use. What do you think?
lines.style: Hesitant mother holding up bottle, seeking expert reassurance

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: ああ、この香料の成分が刺激になっている可能性が高いですね。
lines.en: Ah, this fragrance ingredient is likely the source of the irritation.
lines.style: Doctor examining label with focused diagnostic certainty and care

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: そうなんですか。先日、湖のほとりに旅行へ行った後から悪化した気がします。
lines.en: Really? It seems to have worsened after our trip to the lakeside the other day.
lines.style: Mother recalling timeline with thoughtful, slightly anxious tone

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 日焼けも重なったのでしょう。今は治療の焦点を保湿に絞りましょう。
lines.en: Sun exposure probably compounded it. Let's narrow our treatment focus to moisturizing for now.
lines.style: Reassuring doctor outlining clear plan with steady authoritative voice

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 強い塗り薬はいったん脇に置いておいたほうがいいですか?
lines.en: Should we set the stronger topical medications aside for the time being?
lines.style: Mother asking practical follow-up question with cautious deference

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、低刺激の製品に変えて、一週間様子を見てください。
lines.en: Yes, please switch to low-irritation products and observe for one week.
lines.style: Doctor closing consultation professionally with clear instructional keigo

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 丁寧に教えてくださって、本当にありがとうございます。
lines.en: Thank you so much for explaining everything so carefully.
lines.style: Grateful mother bowing slightly with relieved sincere appreciation
